text: No tests changed in this landing. Needed current tests and callback bindings were read. The assertion at 420–423 describes updated messages deleted from store but checks listener.deletedItemIds.length; that list records onMessageDeleted for moved/deleted items, while onMessageUpdated records a separate updated list. The coincident count2 does not establish updated-store invalidation. This is a proposed assertion-target correction, not an applied fix or observed test failure. Separate folder integration body/store-token checks are recorded under2209. A focused proposed correction is to assert the actual updated callback identities in this listener test and keep content/store behavior in the folder integration fixture. No code edit was requested or made.
